label: 사당
note: Correction vs the original brief: the alpha silhouette is ONE continuous roof ridge (the shrine building itself), not a separate gate+wall structure. The front gate/threshold is a narrow forward projection of the shrine's own base (x~1266-1326, extending to row 575), captured automatically by finished_alpha. Two tiny decorative corner-wall-post fragments (19-20px tall, y~463-483) sit outside the shrine body's x-range; they are not hidden by anything generated, so they are pure crops at their own window, included from stage 1 onward.
